title: Pi Lifecycle Evidence Schema
description: HARNESS ARTIFACT — non-invasive diagnostic tooling schema for Pi lifecycle process-creation tracing. Defines marker and process-event record shapes. Do not modify schema after evidence capture without provenance notation.

ShellIndicators.description: Shell/console lineage classification from observable process-tree indicators. HYPOTHESIS: window visibility not directly observable through WMI.

is_shell_process.description: Whether this child process itself is a recognized shell executable.

shell_kind.description: Kind of shell if is_shell_process is true.

has_terminal_ancestor.description: Whether any ancestor in the process chain is a recognized terminal/shell.

has_conhost_nearby.description: Whether conhost.exe appears within ±1s of this event.

WindowConsoleObservations.description: Window/console observations. WMI cannot observe window handles or creation flags directly — most fields are HYPOTHESIS only.

observable.description: Whether window/console state was directly observable (true only for ETW/ProcMon sources; false for WMI-only).

flags.description: Observed or inferred creation/window flags (e.g., 'CREATE_NO_WINDOW', 'WindowStyle Hidden').

RawWMIEvent.description: Raw Win32_ProcessStartTrace fields as captured from WMI, preserved even when enrichment fails.

MarkerRecord.description: Action marker record written by the human operator or automation at lifecycle boundaries.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle path this marker belongs to.

sequence.description: Monotonic sequence number within the run.

timestamp_local.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with local timezone offset.

collector_pid.description: PID of the process writing this marker.

metadata.description: Path-specific metadata (shell PID, launch command, etc.).

shell_kind.description: Kind of shell if launched from terminal.

shell_pid.description: PID of the shell process when launched from terminal.

pi_pid.description: PID of the Pi process at marker time.

ProcessStartRecord.description: Process-creation event record captured from WMI Win32_ProcessStartTrace, enriched with Win32_Process queries.

timestamp_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of process creation event.

timestamp_local.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with local timezone offset.

child_pid.description: Process ID of the newly created process.

child_process_name.description: Image name of the child process (e.g., 'cmd.exe').

child_executable_path.description: Full path to the child executable, if available via WMI enrichment.

child_command_line.description: Full command line of the child process, if available via WMI enrichment. MAY CONTAIN SENSITIVE DATA.

parent_pid.description: Process ID of the parent process.

parent_process_name.description: Image name of the parent process, if available.

parent_executable_path.description: Full path to the parent executable, if available.

parent_command_line.description: Full command line of the parent process, if available. MAY CONTAIN SENSITIVE DATA.

user_sid.description: User SID, if available from WMI.

enrichment_status.description: Whether Win32_Process enrichment completed before process exit.

raw_event.description: Raw WMI event fields preserved for audit.

window_name.description: Name of the correlation window this event falls into.

offset_ms_from_window_start.description: Millisecond offset from core window start.

in_core_window.description: Whether this event falls inside the core window (not just the expanded window).
